Downloads.Description:
If you'd rather have this recolor for Content Patcher, download this file and extract it into:

Mods -> [CP] H&W Greenhouse Furniture

This will replace the original DarkFurnitureFront.png and Furniture_Dark.png files.

Added recolors for all the new furniture items from HxW Greenhouse Furniture Plus!

Meant to be used alongside the original furniture mod.
